bio.text: Moshe Landman is the Green Party candidate for Maryland's 6th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.

He was born in Washington, D.C., and earned a bachelor's degree from Yeshiva University in 2000, a graduate degree from George Mason University in 2003, and a J.D. from Georgetown University Law Center in 2006.
His career includes working as an attorney, commercial mortgage broker and artificial intelligence consultant, and founding Landman Law, Maryland Metal and Maryland Medicinals.
